	A drawer lane, so the drawer coral has a specimen at all.
	
	🚩 Added 2026-08-12. The feature above had href="#about" from the day this specimen was
	written, and no about lane for it to open — the trigger pointed at nothing, and

	left the package. So the coral had zero specimen coverage AND a dangling trigger, and neither
	said so.

## drawer: more | Specimen — a second drawer

- [ ] %% card: text %%
	🚩 Added 2026-08-12, and the reason is worth keeping: a SECOND drawer is what tells "the drawers
	came with it" apart from "the first drawer came with it". The editor harness asserted two, because
	it was written against a real card that happened to have two; with one drawer in the specimen that
	assertion could only ever be red, and an off-by-one that kept just the first lane would have been
	invisible either way. One of anything is a weak specimen.
